lakes.name: Silver Lake (Madison)
lakes.clarity: Oligotrophic (NHDES/UNH LLMP); high transparency, active association monitoring
lakes.motors: Unrestricted power/ski; PWC banned 2000; houseboats prohibited
lakes.blurb: Quiet forested White-Mtn-edge archetype: clear water, ski-legal, jetski-free, real camps; compound via 2-3-parcel assembly is realistic.

lakes.name: Lake Wentworth
lakes.blurb: Big, clear, PWC-free, wooded shores with islands; Wolfeboro amenities 5 min; frontage trades but compounds rare.

lakes.name: Pleasant Lake (New London)
lakes.blurb: Deep, gin-clear, Kearsarge backdrop, 4-hour drive; tradeoff is scarce, expensive frontage on a smaller lake.

lakes.name: Highland Lake (Stoddard)
lakes.clarity: Mesotrophic (NHDES VLAP N+S stations); decent clarity, slight tea stain
lakes.motors: Unrestricted; ski common; no PWC ban listed
lakes.blurb: Wildest Monadnock big-lake: 7 miles of largely conserved forest, loons, cheap camps; water good-not-gin-clear.

lakes.name: Spofford Lake
lakes.motors: 40 mph day/20 night; ski culture strong
lakes.blurb: Closest passing lake to NYC; deep, clear, ski-friendly; tradeoff: fully ringed cottage road, little wild shore.

lakes.name: Ossipee Lake
lakes.blurb: Huge clear sandy lake plus quiet bays (Broad/Leavitt/Berry); caveat: weekend sandbar party scene and campgrounds.

lakes.name: Lake Winnisquam
lakes.clarity: Oligotrophic per NHDES table; watershed plan active; good clarity
lakes.blurb: NH's 4th-largest, ski-perfect and affordable; Ferry Point 13BR lodge = instant compound; south end is busy Rt-3 corridor.

lakes.name: Goose Pond (Canaan)
lakes.motors: Ski legal; PWC banned 1989; Narrows no-wake
lakes.blurb: Forested, jetski-free sleeper near Hanover; caveat: deep winter drawdown (2024 dam-work year extreme) and fewer services.

lakes.name: Nubanusit Lake
lakes.clarity: Oligotrophic, deep coldwater; among region's clearest (NHDES VLAP)
lakes.blurb: Trout-Lake-grade clarity, Harris-Center-conserved forest, 4 hours out — but frontage almost never trades; zero listings now.

lakes.name: Little Squam Lake
lakes.motors: Ski legal; PWC banned 1988; channel no-wake
lakes.blurb: Size-exception justified: full boat access to Big Squam; watch = price and sub-450 acreage; Phase-0 homes exist.

lakes.name: Lake Umbagog
lakes.motors: Motorboating permitted incl. refuge waters; ski legal
lakes.blurb: True wilderness (eagles, refuge shoreline) at edge-drive 7:00; scarce private frontage, stained shallow water; exceptional-fit override.

lakes.name: First Connecticut Lake
lakes.clarity: Cold, clear oligotrophic salmon water (NHDES trend reporting)
lakes.motors: Unrestricted; ski legal though water stays cold
lakes.blurb: Spectacular timber-country lake; edge 7:05 drive, thin camp inventory, short cold season — exceptional-fit watch only.

lakes.name: Lake Sunapee
lakes.blurb: Water is superb but harbor/regatta scene reads borderline-busy and $2.5M buys one house, never a compound.

lakes.name: Lovell Lake
lakes.motors: Ski legal; no PWC ban listed
lakes.blurb: Surprisingly clear Wakefield sleeper; watch: AWWA phosphorus/cyano-frequency project and Rt-109/village edge.

lakes.name: Bow Lake
lakes.clarity: Mesotrophic, decent clarity; episodic cyanobacteria advisories (NHDES issued/removed)
lakes.blurb: Right size/drive/ski culture; watch item is recurring short cyanobacteria advisories and busier southern-NH feel.

lakes.name: Lake Waukewan
lakes.clarity: Oligo/mesotrophic; Meredith water supply with formal cyanobacteria response plan (2025)
lakes.blurb: Pretty, jetski-free, near Squam; watch: drinking-water-supply politics and active cyano monitoring plan.

lakes.name: Mascoma Lake
lakes.clarity: Mesotrophic, moderate clarity; variable milfoil documented (NHDES)
lakes.blurb: Shaker-village charm 15 min from Dartmouth; watch: milfoil history, I-89/rail-trail adjacency, colored water.

lakes.name: Pine River Pond
lakes.blurb: Wooded, jetski-free, honest camp lake; watch: dense small-lot ring, winter drawdown, limited wow-factor.

lakes.name: Little Lake Sunapee
lakes.blurb: Quiet New London alternative when Pleasant is unobtainable; watch: barely 471 ac and near-zero inventory.
